records.subject: Still want to get Silver Media set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Silver Media set up
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Silver Media* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:52af5b74, email:fd3afdb6) despite a held onboarding call (calendar:bd41f384). Engagement is passive and no tickets filed, suggesting low self-driven momentum in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. Picking up where we left off: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project is the best first step. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time once you're ready.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and get that first project set up with you -- just reply with a time that suits.

Best,
Priya
